bio.text: Berny Jacques represents District 59 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Jacques was elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.
The House lists Jacques's residence as Seminole and an occupation of attorney. Jacques was born in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, and moved to Florida in 1994.
Jacques studied history and political studies at Washington Adventist University (2005-2009) and holds a J.D. from Stetson University College of Law (2012).
